results.name: duplicates
results.message: Found 2430 duplicate mechanism signature(s) across 2430 distinct location(s). The same fault path appears more than once in the DEM, which typically happens when sub-circuit DEMs are concatenated without merging coincident mechanisms. Duplicate probabilities should be XOR-folded as p_eff = p1*(1-p2) + p2*(1-p1) (iterated for 3+), not left as separate entries.
